abilities.description: Can read pressure and flow in the reclamation system by sound and touch, and can isolate or restore any section of the cistern.
abilities.name: Valve Mastery

abilities.description: Remembers decades of water ledger entries and can spot falsified figures.
abilities.name: Ledger Memory

characters.arc: Maren moves from defiant leverage-holder to a pragmatic negotiator who surrenders some control of the valves to secure a binding, shared water trust.
characters.description: A weathered Ring Seven reclamation engineer in her late forties, Maren has spent twenty years tuning the cistern valves in the Cistern Undercroft. She is lean and sun-lamp tanned, with permanently stained fingertips and a patched grey coverall. She sits on the Seventh Assembly and cast the deciding vote to sever the elevators. She grew up in the paddies during the Blight Year and remembers her mother's rations being cut.
characters.external_conflict: The Concord demands the elevators reopen while radicals in her own Assembly want to cut the water outright.
characters.flaw: Stubborn pride that makes her treat compromise as betrayal of the dead.
characters.goal: Negotiate formal recognition and fair water-and-grain terms before the valves are forced open or sabotaged.
characters.internal_conflict: She wrote the water ledger's public-trust ethic into her own conscience, yet she now holds the valves as a weapon.
characters.motivation: To make sure the ring that keeps everyone alive is finally treated as a partner, not a servant.
characters.name: Maren Okoye

abilities.description: Knows every protocol and legal lever of ship governance and can bind other officials to it.
abilities.name: Procedural Command

abilities.description: Understands the ship's course-correction and rotation balance well enough to see how the severance threatens it.
abilities.name: Navigation Oversight

characters.arc: Dario's rigid authority erodes under shortages until he must either concede the tithe was a mistake or lose the Concord entirely; he ends by conceding.
characters.description: Chief Steward of the Concord of Helm, Dario is a precise, silver-haired man in his sixties who has never set foot outside Helm Ring One. He wears the formal navy tunic of the Concord and keeps a physical copy of the ship's founding charter on his desk. He authored the Ration Tithe in the Middle Voyage.
characters.external_conflict: Helm Ring One is running short of fresh produce, and hardliners on his council push for riskier moves than he wants.
characters.flaw: Paternalistic certainty that he alone sees the whole ship, which blinds him to Ring Seven's real grievances.
characters.goal: Force the elevators open and bring Ring Seven back under unified command without breaching a hull.
characters.internal_conflict: He privately knows the Ration Tithe was excessive but cannot admit it without discrediting the Concord.
characters.motivation: To preserve the ship's unity because he believes any fracture will lead to the mass death of the crew.
characters.name: Dario Vance

abilities.description: Can climb and map the elevator shafts and sever-damaged cabins in near darkness.
abilities.name: Shaft Navigation

abilities.description: Skilled at negotiating prices and terms with factions that distrust each other.
abilities.name: Brokered Passage

characters.arc: Tamsin shifts from profiteering neutrality to choosing a side on principle, risking her guild to protect the stranded passengers.
characters.description: The young leader of the Shaft Climbers, Tamsin is wiry and scarred, in her late twenties, with hands calloused from cable work and a braided safety line always coiled at her hip. She learned the shafts from her father, who died in a coupling fall. She now guides cabin crews and sells passage to whoever pays.
characters.external_conflict: Both the Assembly and the Concord pressure her to carry their agents and deny the other, and saboteurs stalk the stranded cabins.
characters.flaw: Distrust of everyone leads her to hedge and delay at moments when commitment is required.
characters.goal: Extract a lasting charter of guild rights from whichever side wins the shaft struggle.
characters.internal_conflict: She wants to stay neutral but knows her neutrality is itself the price both sides pay for.
characters.motivation: To keep her guild alive and independent after losing her father to a shaft accident.
characters.name: Tamsin Rook

abilities.description: Can speak to both Helm and Ring Seven in their own idioms and carry delicate offers.
abilities.name: Back-Channel Diplomacy

characters.arc: Joss goes from double-dealing go-between to a trusted witness whose honest testimony makes the final settlement possible.
characters.description: A Concord liaison officer in his thirties, Joss is a former paddy-hand from Ring Seven who rose into Helm service. He has a clipped Helm accent over a farmland drawl and wears the Concord blue with a small woven grain-stalk pin he never removes. He was sent to open back channels to Ring Seven.
characters.external_conflict: Dario suspects his loyalty, and the Assembly sees him as a spy.
characters.flaw: Eagerness to be liked leads him to promise more than he can deliver to both sides.
characters.goal: Secure a private meeting between Dario Vance and Maren Okoye in the shafts.
characters.internal_conflict: He is loyal to the Concord that raised him and to the ring that birthed him, and cannot serve both.
characters.motivation: To end the standoff without a hull breach that would kill his family still living on Ring Seven.
characters.name: Joss Halvorsen

relationships.description: Maren Okoye and Dario Vance are bitter opponents: she holds the valves that feed and water his ring, while he holds the legal authority to call her secession a mutiny. Each sees the other as responsible for the Blight Year's wounds.
Dario Vance regards Maren Okoye as the most dangerous voice in the Seventh Assembly and quietly seeks to isolate her from more radical colleagues to force a negotiated surrender.
Tamsin Rook carries Maren Okoye's engineers and water technicians through the shafts for a price, but their trust is strained by Tamsin's willingness to also carry Concord agents.
Joss Halvorsen serves Dario Vance as a liaison, yet Dario distrusts him because of his Ring Seven origins, creating pressure on Joss to prove his loyalty.
Joss Halvorsen hires Tamsin Rook to guide him through the shafts for secret talks with Maren Okoye, and Tamsin demands steadily higher payment and guild guarantees.
